target: Simple daily habits, schedule, and pause recovery

contract.purpose: Replace unwanted habits, track good ones, plan a day and run its entries with honest interruption logging.
contract.purposeSource: Owner direction on 7 September 2026 and PRODUCT.md
contract.canonicalPurpose: Anchor helps a person plan a realistic day, follow the current intention, and learn why the day lived differed from the day planned.
contract.driftNote: Owner simplified the product to habits, editable daily schedules, project context and interruption recovery; progression and daily confirmation are no longer primary flows.
contract.audience: The owner using an iPhone and Mac throughout an ordinary day.
contract.job: Check off a habit or schedule and play an entry without configuring a behavior programme.
contract.thesis: Preserve The Drawn Day but give the actual daily actions the prominent controls.
contract.system: Existing paper/charcoal, native SF type, Anchor spacing, restrained ink actions and original doodles.
contract.signature: A drawn day with directly playable entries and habits that can be checked off without a time.
contract.risk: Removing progression prompts changes familiar placement; preserve saved history and keep editing available.

findings: Native SwiftUI review, not a browser rendering. Phone-width catalog images use macOS controls; actual iOS journeys are recorded separately.
Large drawn header retained from the existing system; a denser layout remains optional polish.
Full Mac UI and physical-device journeys remain release gates; visual scores do not qualify them.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner specified the simpler workflow and asked for phone and Mac readiness for tomorrow.
